name: Ella Rock Trek Centre
description: Ella Rock Trek Centre, an adventure park nestled in the lush hills of Badulla, offers trekkers and nature enthusiasts opportunities to scale the rock faces, capture breathtaking nature photographs, and observe diverse bird species. The park, established by local mountaineers and conservationists, has become a popular destination for those seeking adventure and appreciation of Sri Lanka's natural beauty. Notable rock climbs include the challenging Ella Rock Trek, which has been a favorite among climbers since its opening. Visitors can also learn about the rich biodiversity of the region, including endemic species found nowhere else on Earth.
activities: Rock Climbing, Nature Photography, Bird Watching
monsoon_note: Jul–Sep dry season; Oct–Nov inter-monsoon rains

name: Ravana Falls Zipline
description: Ravana Falls Zipline, an adrenaline-pumping adventure park in Badulla, offers visitors ziplining through the lush jungle canopy, heart-pounding rides, and nature walks. Named after the mythical character Ravana, it attracts thrill-seekers seeking an exhilarating experience high above the Ravana Falls, a stunning waterfall located nearby. The park features over 30 zip lines, with some reaching up to 500 meters, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape. Visitors can also take part in guided nature walks led by experienced guides who share fascinating stories of the area's rich biodiversity and local culture.

name: Namunukula Summit Hike
description: Namunukula Summit Hike is a popular hiking trail in the Badulla district, offering panoramic views of tea plantations and the Namunukula Forest Reserve. The summit provides an ideal spot for photography enthusiasts, with its lush greenery and distant mountain vistas. Visitors can also opt for a tea plantation tour, learning about the traditional methods of growing and processing tea. This hike has been a favorite among locals and tourists alike, attracting those seeking natural beauty and cultural insights into Sri Lanka’s tea industry.

name: Zipline Start
description: Zipline Start is an attraction located in Badulla, Sri Lanka. It's a popular spot for a family day out.

name: Zipline End
description: Zipline End, an adventure park nestled in the lush hills of Badulla, offers families and thrill-seekers an array of rides and fun activities. Originally established as a local community project, the park now attracts visitors from across the country seeking adrenaline-pumping ziplines, thrilling roller coasters, and gentle rides suitable for all ages. Its location in the heart of the hill country makes it a popular spot for day trips and weekend getaways, offering a perfect blend of excitement and relaxation.
